product.name: Active Leakage Control Systems
product.description: Systems for detecting, monitoring, and reducing water-network leakage by regulating pressure and identifying abnormal flow conditions.

product.name: Hydraulic Valves
product.description: Hydraulic valves for controlling water flow, pressure, and distribution in industrial and utility systems.

product.name: Metering Solutions
product.description: Equipment and solutions for measuring fluid flow and consumption in water and hydraulic networks.

product.name: Hydraulic Control Systems
product.description: Control equipment and integrated solutions for managing pressure, flow, and hydraulic-system operation.
